card.name: Stock label phrases: breastfeeding and visual inspection
card.fires_on: Small words inside fixed label sentences, such as "on" in "adverse effects on the breastfed infant", "made" in "a decision should be made", and "visually" in "should be inspected visually".

modes.label: Lactation sentences
modes.description: The linking word or verb inside the standard nursing-mother statement.
modes.example: any potential adverse effects<< on>> the breastfed infant from Oxycod

modes.label: Visual inspection of injections
modes.description: The word "visually" or "is" in the check for particulate matter and discoloration.
modes.example: Parenteral drug products should be inspected<< visually>> for particulate matter and discoloration

modes.label: Rounding volumes
modes.description: The verb "round" in instructions for calculated volumes.
modes.example: For volumes less than 1 mL,<< round>> to the nearest 0.1 mL
